en.coach.title: Weekly reflection
en.coach.subtitle: A few kind, small steps from your week — worked out on this device.
en.coach.privacy: Worked out on this device from your own tracking. Nothing is sent anywhere, and private journals share only counts.
en.coach.disclaimer: For questions about your own situation, consult a qualified scholar.
en.coach.searchKeywords: weekly coach, weekly reflection, weekly report, insights, tips, progress, gentle coach
en.coach.summary.title: Your week at a glance
en.coach.summary.perfect: Days with all five on time
en.coach.summary.adhkar: Days with morning or evening adhkar
en.coach.quiet.title: A fresh week
en.coach.quiet.body: Nothing was tracked in this week — and that's okay. Whenever you're ready, start with a single salah.
en.coach.hiddenToast: Hidden. You can bring hidden tips back at the bottom of this page.
en.coach.snoozedToast: The card will come back with next week's reflection.
en.coach.goal.title: A small goal for this week
en.coach.goal.accepted: Goal set — we'll look at it together on {{date}}, in sha Allah.
en.coach.goal.last.title: Last week's goal
en.coach.goal.last.progress: You reached {{value}} of {{target}} — every step counts. Keep going, and ask Allah to make it easy.
en.coach.goal.kind.fard_days: All five on time — {{target}} of 7 days
en.coach.goal.kind.fajr_sunnah_days: The two rakahs before Fajr — {{target}} of 7 days
en.coach.goal.kind.adhkar_days: Morning or evening adhkar — {{target}} of 7 days

en.coach.goal.kind.family_contact: Calls, visits or messages to family this week: {{target}}
en.coach.rule.excused_week.title: Rest and return
en.coach.rule.excused_week.body.hayd: Your streak is safe. Rest without guilt — zikr and dua stay open to you whenever you like.
en.coach.rule.excused_week.body.nifas: Your streak is safe. Rest and recover — zikr and dua stay open to you whenever you like.
en.coach.rule.excused_week.body.sick: Your streak is safe. Rest and recover, and pray as you are able. The reward of what you used to do when well continues, in sha Allah.
en.coach.rule.excused_week.body.travel: Your streak is safe. Travel safely — the reward of what you used to do at home continues, in sha Allah. Your school's view on shortening salah is in the travel guide.
en.coach.rule.excused_week.body.generic: Your streak is safe. Rest, and return whenever you're ready.
en.coach.rule.personal_best.title: A new personal best
en.coach.rule.personal_best.body: Your longest salah streak yet: {{days}} days. Alhamdulillah — what you've done stays with you.
en.coach.rule.improvement.title: Growing, Alhamdulillah
en.coach.rule.improvement.body.fard: Salah on time this week: {{done}} of {{total}} — more than in your recent weeks. Keep it small and steady.
en.coach.rule.improvement.body.rawatib: Sunnah rawatib this week: {{done}} of {{total}} — more than in your recent weeks. Keep it small and steady.
en.coach.rule.improvement.body.quran: Days with the Qur'an: {{done}} of {{total}} — more than in your recent weeks. Keep it small and steady.
en.coach.rule.improvement.body.adhkar: Days with morning or evening adhkar: {{done}} of {{total}} — more than in your recent weeks. Keep it small and steady.
en.coach.rule.quran_streak.title: Close to the Qur'an
en.coach.rule.quran_streak.body: You spent time with the Qur'an on {{done}} of 7 days. May Allah make it a light for you.
en.coach.rule.habit_consistent.title: Steady habits
en.coach.rule.habit_consistent.body.one: You kept “{{habit}}” every day this week.
en.coach.rule.habit_consistent.body.many: Habits you kept every day this week: {{done}}.
en.coach.rule.adhkar_steady.title: Remembering Allah
en.coach.rule.adhkar_steady.body: Morning or evening adhkar on {{done}} of 7 days. A lovely way to begin and end the day.
en.coach.rule.fasting_kept.title: Voluntary fasting
en.coach.rule.fasting_kept.body: Voluntary fasts kept this week: {{done}}. May Allah accept them from you.
en.coach.rule.muhasabah_steady.title: Taking stock
en.coach.rule.muhasabah_steady.body: Nights you paused to reflect this week: {{done}}.
en.coach.rule.showed_up.title: You showed up
en.coach.rule.showed_up.body: You tracked your worship on {{done}} of 7 days. Every small step counts.
en.coach.rule.fajr_gap.title: Making Fajr easier
en.coach.rule.fajr_gap.body.bedtime: Fajr on time: {{done}} of {{total}} days, while your other salah are steadier. Going to sleep a little before {{bedtime}} and reciting the before-sleep adhkar can help.
en.coach.rule.fajr_gap.body.noBedtime: Fajr on time: {{done}} of {{total}} days, while your other salah are steadier. Sleeping a little earlier and reciting the before-sleep adhkar can help.
en.coach.rule.delayed_pattern.title: Making {{prayer}} easier
en.coach.rule.delayed_pattern.body: {{prayer}} came later than you'd like on {{done}} days this week. An earlier reminder might help.
en.coach.rule.weekday_dip.title: A plan for {{weekday}}
en.coach.rule.weekday_dip.body: For three weeks, {{weekday}} has been the hardest day for salah on time. A small plan for that day — a reminder, or knowing where you'll pray — can make it easier.
en.coach.rule.family_ties_due.title: Family ties
en.coach.rule.family_ties_due.body: A parent would love to hear from you this week.
en.coach.rule.khatm_behind.title: Your khatm plan
en.coach.rule.khatm_behind.body: Your plan has moved about {{days}} days ahead of your reading. A gentler pace still reaches a khatm — you can adjust the plan anytime.
en.coach.rule.qaza_pace.title: Your qaza plan
en.coach.rule.qaza_pace.body.pace: Qaza left: {{remaining}}. At your current pace you'd finish around {{date}} — one more a day would bring that about {{sooner}} days sooner.
en.coach.rule.qaza_pace.body.start: Qaza left: {{remaining}}. Even one a day adds up — make them up gently, and ask Allah's forgiveness for what was missed.
en.coach.rule.khushu_low_prayer.title: Presence in {{prayer}}
en.coach.rule.khushu_low_prayer.body: {{prayer}} has felt harder to focus in lately. Learning the meaning of what you recite can help the heart be present.
en.coach.rule.rawatib_start.title: A next step: the sunnah
en.coach.rule.rawatib_start.body: Your fard salah were steady this week — Alhamdulillah. A lovely next step is the two rakahs before Fajr.
en.coach.rule.jama_rate.title: Your home masjid
en.coach.rule.jama_rate.body: Could one salah this week be with the congregation at your masjid?
